decision: assignment docs/decisions.md section 23 (further business sources): jrea-zgmq loaded for Travis outlets; individual-owner rows get a privacy classification; no SSN-derived taxpayer number is served

load.name: tx-comptroller-sales-tax-travis
load.scope: Travis outlets: outlet_county_code='227' (the outlet's county), capture of 2026-10-17T10:31:10.000Z under US egress

privacy.row_sha256_basis: classed rows: the captured row with the withheld cells emptied

watermark.scope: Travis outlets: outlet_county_code='227' (the outlet's county), capture of 2026-10-17T10:31:10.000Z under US egress

keys.reconciliation: 49,025 = 39,554 printed (taxpayer, outlet) keys + 9,471 sole-owner rows; the outlet county of every row is 227

privacy_classification.rule: travis-t3-privacy.v1 (src/counties/travis/t3-sources.mjs salesTaxPrivacyClass): a row whose taxpayer_organization_type is IS (sole owner) is individual_owner; its taxpayer_number is withheld
privacy_classification.why_only_IS: only a natural person has a Social Security number; IS is the only natural-person organization type in the 39 types the Travis outlets print; partnerships, estates and trusts get an employer or Comptroller-assigned number. Consistency check offline: no IS taxpayer name carries an entity word (LLC, INC, CORP, ...) against 99.6% of CL names

can_numbers_be_ssn_based.answer: possibly for IS rows, never for the other types; none of the 2026-10-17 numbers has the leading 2 commonly documented for SSN-based Texas taxpayer numbers, but the dataset's record layout (the Socrata attachment 'Active Sales Tax Permit Record Layout.pdf') was not captured, so the numbering scheme is not confirmed from a Comptroller source and the rule withholds every IS number whatever its form
can_numbers_be_ssn_based.franchise_statewide_shapes: first digit 3 on 3,203,317 and 1 on 284,345 of 3,487,662 rows, all 11 digits; the franchise file prints no IS rows (entities only)

privacy_classification.what_is_stored: in the snapshot a classed row keeps every other printed column; taxpayer_number and taxpayer_number__trimmed are null, _privacy_class is individual_owner, _withheld_columns is taxpayer_number, and _row_sha256 hashes the captured row with that cell emptied; the row has no printed key and is keyed by that redacted hash, so a later capture of a changed sole-owner outlet appears as one tombstone plus one new row
privacy_classification.raw_capture: the window capture itself (gitignored runtime data/, receipt-verified) holds the numbers as fetched; it is the evidence of record and is never loaded into a derived store without this rule
contract_items_for_the_operator: api-contract.md business_record_id is the SHA-256 of the source key and the printed key; for a withheld row that digest can be reversed by enumerating 11-digit numbers, which contradicts 'they never expose a withheld number'; the internal snapshot keys withheld rows by the redacted row hash instead

api-contract.md unpublished_source.row_sha256 'hashes the row as captured'; for a withheld row the captured-row hash can be searched for the number in the same way; the snapshot stores the redacted-row hash instead

reload.merge_reason: the hash index covers every (path, artifact hash) and the content diff is empty

open: whether the lexicon's Business_Location fits outlets is a mew lookup (section 23); not needed for T3, since business records are not published
private_boundary: counts and digests only (no names, numbers or addresses)
names_note: the load's collision summary keys on (taxpayer, outlet), so the outlets of one taxpayer count as a shared name (42,216 taxpayers hold the 49,025 outlets); the matcher index of step 6 keys this source on the taxpayer
